questions.question: What warning did CIA Director John Ratcliffe deliver to Russian officials during his secret trip to Moscow?
options: End all oil sales to China within 30 days
Accept Ukraine’s NATO membership before winter
Withdraw Russian troops from Iran immediately
Do not attack NATO territory
questions.explanation: Ratcliffe warned Russian officials not to attack NATO territory and shared a U.S. assessment that Moscow should negotiate an end to its war in Ukraine before conditions worsen.

questions.question: Who did Trump urge South Carolina Republicans to support in a special Senate runoff?
options: Ralph Norman
Darline Graham
Lindsey Graham
Annie Andrews
questions.explanation: Trump urged voters to support interim Sen. Darline Graham over Rep. Ralph Norman and told them to “pretend, please, that I’m on the ballot.”

questions.question: Why did Trump plan to temporarily suspend tariffs on ground beef imports?
options: To punish Canada for retaliatory tariffs
To replace beef imports lost because of the Iran war
To lower record-high beef prices
To meet a new trade commitment with Europe
questions.explanation: The plan would allow up to 300,000 metric tons of ground beef into the U.S. in an effort to lower record-high beef prices.

questions.question: What did Judge Indira Talwani do regarding Trump’s mail-voting order?
options: Required Congress to approve it before implementation
Ordered the Postal Service to delay it until after November
Ruled that all of its restrictions were unconstitutional
Lifted the final nationwide injunction blocking it
questions.explanation: Talwani lifted her injunction after the Supreme Court ruled that a related challenge was premature, allowing the Postal Service to impose new ballot requirements ahead of the November midterms.

questions.question: How many people did ICE arrest in July?
questions.explanation: ICE arrested a record 49,571 people in July, and nearly 34,000 people were deported that month.

questions.question: What did Trump claim about the U.S. war with Iran?
options: The U.S. was “achieving a very big victory” and the conflict would continue as long as necessary
The U.S. had agreed to restart negotiations within 90 days
The U.S. would withdraw forces from the region by Labor Day
The U.S. would pause military operations to clear mines from the Strait of Hormuz
questions.explanation: Trump said the U.S. was “achieving a very big victory” in the nearly six-month war and that he had “no time schedule” for ending it.

questions.question: How did Canada respond to Trump’s new tariffs on Canadian goods?
options: It retaliated with duties of up to 50% on U.S. goods
It filed a lawsuit in U.S. federal court against the tariffs
It suspended all automobile exports to the United States
It agreed to reopen trade talks without imposing countermeasures
questions.explanation: Canada imposed duties of up to 50% on about $20 billion in American goods, matching Trump’s latest duties “dollar for dollar, rate for rate.”

questions.question: What did Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent call the expanded sanctions campaign against Iran?
options: Operation Tehran Isolation
Operation Financial Firewall
Operation Economic Outcast
Operation Maximum Leverage
questions.explanation: Treasury broadened sanctions as part of “Operation Economic Outcast,” which Bessent described as an “economic onslaught against Iran’s financial connections around the globe.”

questions.question: What was the annual U.S. inflation rate in July?
questions.explanation: Annual U.S. inflation was 3.7% in July, unchanged from June and still well above the Fed’s 2% target.

questions.question: What did Trump’s executive order rename Lake Ontario?
options: Lake America
Lake Trump
Lake Liberty
Lake North America
questions.explanation: Trump signed an executive order requiring the federal government to use the name “Lake America” for Lake Ontario, though it does not compel Canada or others to adopt the change.
